messages:
jo: Quick brainstorm  Idea: pair a short launch post + 30-min demo with a micro-influencer co-post. Test two narratives: 'benchmarks-first' (latency/cost/time-to-launch) vs 'story-first' (customer outcome story). Drive signups into two onboarding flows with different prompt template packs and a tiered credit nudge.
sam_marketing: Love the co-post angle. Micro-influencers = dev advocates who can show a 10-min clip. Hypothesis: social proof reduces time-to-first-success. KPI set: webinar->signup, signup->first_prompt_run(<24h), credits_used_within_72h. Can analytics add cohort filters?
rheya: Copy ideas: benchmarks-first: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency, 2x lower token cost in benchmarked workloads." story-first: "How a small team shipped customer automation and cut support MTTR." CTAs: 'Claim starter credits' vs 'Watch short clip + claim credits'.
max_sdr: Routing ask: add utm=infl_bench|infl_story to links and auto-assign cohort. If company email & tokens_7d>1000 => hot SDR queue. Also surface 'influencer_ref' so we know which co-post drove the signup. SLA: first touch <=4h for hot leads.
ops-bot: Routing rule queued. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"infl_bench","ref":"jo_infl_01"}'
``` -> sets user.cohort=infl_bench and posts to #sales-inbound. :white_check_mark:
jo: Onboarding differences: bench flow gets a 3-template pack focused on performance prompts + a one-click perf test harness. story flow gets 3 playbook templates + a short 'how we shipped' walkthrough. Both get 48h starter credits, but bench flow receives an instant micro-benchmark nudge in product (run x, see y).
sam_marketing: Micro-influencer plan: ask them to post a 2-min clip + a short thread showing a perf comparison. Include unique referral param for attribution. Offer them credits and a co-branded landing.
rheya: Landing options: variant A (bench): shows three mini-benchmarks with simple visuals, CTA: 'Run benchmark in your stack.' Variant B (story): shows a short quote + customer snapshot, CTA: 'See the demo & claim credits.' Include hidden field 'use_case' and 'influencer_ref'.
analytics-bot: I'll emit event spec: 'influencer_click' {ref,cohort}, 'first_prompt_run' {cohort,template_id}, 'credit_grant' {cohort,amount}, 'perf_test_run' {latency_ms,tokens}. Cohort must be included on all events. Dashboard will have cohort compare panel.
max_sdr: SDR workflow: for hot leads, post to #sales-inbound with company, tokens_7d, cohort, influencer_ref, use_case. Send intro email within SLA offering 15-min setup help and reminder credits expire 48h.
ops-bot: Tracking snippet for the in-product perf nudge: ```html
<button id=\"run-perf\">Run micro-benchmark</button>
<script>document.getElementById('run-perf').addEventListener('click',()=>track('perf_test_run',{cohort:'infl_bench',latency_ms:/*value*/,tokens:/*value*/}));</script>
```
sam_marketing: Credit strategy: A/B test immediate 2k credits vs staggered (1k immediate + 1.5k after first_prompt_run). Also test an 'extra influencer credit' code only redeemable via the influencer link to measure uplift from social proof.
rheya: Prompt packs will live in /docs/prompt-templates/influencer-1755555555.md. Bench pack = perf_runner, latency-optimized-generator, cost-aware-summarizer. Story pack = onboarding-playbook, customer-email-generator, qa-retrieval-starter. I'll draft examples and short 'how to run' snippets.
analytics-bot: Please ensure we tag 'first_prompt_run' with property 'source' = 'landing'|'in_product_demo'|'influencer_clip' so we can split attribution.
jo: Timeline: copy + co-post brief by Wed EOD, landing variants live Thu AM, routing + tracking live Thu noon, dashboard ready Fri, demo Mon 10am PT. Any blockers?
max_sdr: Need co-branded landing template and influencer referral field in registration. Also want a quick summary card for SDRs with suggested outreach lines.
sam_marketing: I'll produce a short influencer brief + referral code generator. Also will draft two short posts and image assets.
ops-bot: Webhook configured to post qualified leads to #sales-inbound. Example payload: ```json
{"email":"{{email}}","cohort":"infl_bench","influencer_ref":"jo_infl_01","tokens_7d":1200}
```
rheya: Will upload prompt packs and landing copy into the thread when ready. Also propose a 24h nudge email: 'Two-minute challenge: run this prompt to see immediate improvement' with a one-click run button.
jo: Great. Keep decisions in this thread. Tag me for copy review. :rocket:
